nodes.name: placement_utils.py
nodes.summary: Master placement helpers that compute shard assignments for pipeline/CFG/tensor parallelism across node cycles, allocate layers proportionally to available memory, and build MLX ring/JACCL host matrices.

nodes.name: filter_cycles_by_memory
nodes.summary: Filters node cycles that have enough aggregate available RAM for a model.

nodes.name: get_smallest_cycles
nodes.summary: Returns the cycles with the fewest nodes.

nodes.name: allocate_layers_proportionally
nodes.summary: Distributes model layers across nodes proportionally to memory fractions using largest-remainder allocation with a minimum of one layer per node.

nodes.name: _compute_total_memory
nodes.summary: Sums available RAM across node IDs and validates it is non-zero.

nodes.name: _allocate_and_validate_layers
nodes.summary: Allocates layers by memory fractions and validates each node can hold its share of the model.

nodes.name: get_shard_assignments_for_pipeline_parallel
nodes.summary: Entry point producing shard assignments for pipeline parallelism, dispatching to CFG or pure-pipeline strategies.

nodes.name: _get_shard_assignments_for_cfg_parallel
nodes.summary: Builds CFG-parallel shard assignments with per-node layer lists and runner IDs.

nodes.name: _get_shard_assignments_for_pure_pipeline
nodes.summary: Builds pure pipeline-parallel shard assignments with one shard per node.

nodes.name: get_shard_assignments_for_tensor_parallel
nodes.summary: Builds tensor-parallel shard assignments covering all nodes in the cycle.

nodes.name: get_shard_assignments
nodes.summary: Top-level dispatcher selecting pipeline or tensor-parallel sharding for a model.

nodes.name: get_mlx_jaccl_devices_matrix
nodes.summary: Builds the device connectivity matrix for MLX JACCL from the topology cycle.

nodes.name: _find_connection_ip
nodes.summary: Finds the best IP for a node pair from the topology connections.

nodes.name: find_ip_prioritised
nodes.summary: Selects the preferred IP for a node by interface-type priority, falling back to topology IPs.

nodes.name: get_mlx_ring_hosts_by_node
nodes.summary: Computes the ordered host list for MLX ring parallelism per node.

nodes.name: get_mlx_jaccl_coordinators
nodes.summary: Derives the coordinator IPs for MLX JACCL from ring host assignments.
